recipients_list.description: List of native recipients (age1...), SSH public keys, or plugin recipients (age1example1...) for encryption. One per line. Comments may be included separately via other fields, but are not required here.

identities_list.description: List of native identities (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...), or identity files for decryption. One per line.

ssh_keys.description: List of paths to SSH private key files used for decryption via age's SSH key support.
